page.notes: The big "A" at the head of the first entry is the section letter, joined to the word "Blastati" as the initial. The entry "Aegyptus muscis abundat" has no printed number on its line; the "77" at the top of the right column seems to belong to it. The final word "ratio" is the catchword; the signature "R" stands at the foot. Handwritten pointer marks in both margins and underlining under "liberatus", "sæpè" and "causa" are not transcribed. "Aethiopū" uses a tilde for -um. Several letters are hard to confirm: "Aephi", "feruadi" and "201" may need checking against the original.
